text_en: The implied GDP deflator turned positive at {q2} year on year in 2026Q2, from {q1} in 2026Q1, after negative readings in every quarter from 2023Q2 to 2026Q1.
text_zh: 隐含GDP平减指数同比在2026年二季度转正，为{q2}，2026年一季度为{q1}；此前2023年二季度至2026年一季度各季均为负值。

text_en: Real GDP grew {rg} year on year in 2026Q2, down from {rg1} in 2026Q1.
text_zh: 2026年二季度实际GDP同比增长{rg}，较一季度的{rg1}有所回落。

text_en: PPI was {p} year on year in 2026-08, against {p0} in 2025-12: factory-gate prices have moved from deflation to inflation within the year.
text_zh: 2026年8月PPI同比为{p}，2025年12月为{p0}：出厂价格已在一年之内由通缩转为通胀。

text_en: Month-on-month PPI momentum has faded: {m4} in 2026-04, then {m6} in 2026-06, {m7} in 2026-07 and {m8} in 2026-08.
text_zh: PPI环比动能有所减弱：2026年4月为{m4}，6月为{m6}，7月为{m7}，8月为{m8}。

text_en: Industrial profits were {pr} year on year, year to date, in 2026-08, after {pr0} for 2025 as a whole.
text_zh: 截至2026年8月，规模以上工业企业利润累计同比为{pr}，2025年全年为{pr0}。

text_en: The PMI output price index rose to {op} in 2026-09 from {op7} in 2026-07, a sign that factory-gate momentum picked up again going into the September PPI release.
text_zh: 制造业PMI出厂价格指数由2026年7月的{op7}升至9月的{op}，显示在9月PPI公布前出厂价格动能再度回升。

text_en: Consumer prices remain subdued: CPI was {c} and core CPI {k} year on year in 2026-08.
text_zh: 消费价格仍然偏弱：2026年8月CPI同比为{c}，核心CPI同比为{k}。

text_en: Brent averaged {b5} a barrel in 2026-05 and {b7} in 2026-07, against {b0} in 2025-12.
text_zh: 布伦特原油均价2026年5月为{b5}/桶，7月为{b7}/桶，2025年12月为{b0}/桶。

text_en: The PPI rise is upstream: producer-goods PPI was {pg} year on year in 2026-08 while consumer-goods PPI was still {cg}.
text_zh: PPI的上涨集中在上游：2026年8月生产资料PPI同比为{pg}，而生活资料PPI同比仍为{cg}。

text_en: Copper averaged {cu} a tonne in 2026-07, against {cu0} a year earlier.
text_zh: 2026年7月铜价均值为{cu}/吨，上年同期为{cu0}/吨。

text_en: The largest PPI gains coincided with the oil spike: PPI moved {m3} and {m4} month on month in 2026-03 and 2026-04, when Brent averaged {b3} and {b4}.
text_zh: PPI涨幅最大的月份与油价飙升同步：2026年3月和4月PPI环比分别为{m3}和{m4}，同期布伦特原油均价分别为{b3}/桶和{b4}/桶。

text_en: Property sales area was {ps} year on year, year to date, in 2026-08: a steeper decline than the {ps0} recorded for 2025 as a whole.
text_zh: 截至2026年8月，商品房销售面积累计同比为{ps}，降幅较2025年全年的{ps0}进一步扩大。

text_en: Net new medium and long-term household loans were {jun} in 2026-06, {jul} in 2026-07 and {aug} in 2026-08 (CNY 100m, derived from PBOC balances): mortgage books are still shrinking on balance.
text_zh: 住户中长期贷款当月净新增：2026年6月为{jun}，7月为{jul}，8月为{aug}（单位：亿元，由中国人民银行存量余额推算）；按揭贷款余额总体上仍在收缩。

text_en: Retail sales grew {r} year on year in 2026-08, against {r0} a year earlier.
text_zh: 2026年8月社会消费品零售总额同比增长{r}，上年同期为{r0}。

text_en: M1 growth was {m} in 2026-08, down from {m0} in 2026-02.
text_zh: 2026年8月M1同比增速为{m}，较2026年2月的{m0}回落。

text_en: Core CPI was {k} in 2026-08, no higher than the {k0} of 2025-12: no sign yet of demand-pull inflation.
text_zh: 2026年8月核心CPI同比为{k}，未高于2025年12月的{k0}：尚无需求拉动型通胀的迹象。

text_en: The manufacturing PMI new orders index was {no} in 2026-09, but its three-month average was {avg}: orders are hovering at the expansion line rather than expanding.
text_zh: 2026年9月制造业PMI新订单指数为{no}，但三个月均值为{avg}：订单在荣枯线附近徘徊，尚未形成扩张。

text_en: Total social financing stock growth slowed to {t} in 2026-08 from {t0} in 2025-12.
text_zh: 社会融资规模存量同比增速由2025年12月的{t0}放缓至2026年8月的{t}。

text_en: General budget expenditure grew only {e} year to date in 2026-07.
text_zh: 截至2026年7月，一般公共预算支出累计同比仅增长{e}。

text_en: The US 10-year Treasury yield averaged {u} in 2026-09, up from {u0} in 2025-12, while the renminbi strengthened to {fx} per dollar from {fx0}.
text_zh: 美国10年期国债收益率2026年9月均值为{u}，较2025年12月的{u0}上行；同期人民币升值至每美元{fx}元，2025年12月为{fx0}元。

text_en: Exports grew {x} year on year in dollar terms in 2026-08, after {x7} in 2026-07.
text_zh: 2026年8月以美元计价的出口同比增长{x}，7月为{x7}。

text_en: The PMI new export orders index was {neo} in 2026-09, at the expansion line, so the export strength is not yet showing up as broad new orders.
text_zh: 2026年9月制造业PMI新出口订单指数为{neo}，恰在荣枯线上，出口的强劲表现尚未转化为广泛的新增订单。

text_en: So far the price turn looks supply-led. It is concentrated in producer goods, it coincides with the oil and metals shock, and it lost momentum when oil eased. That fits H0 better than a demand-led recovery.
text_zh: 到目前为止，价格拐点更像是供给端驱动：涨幅集中在生产资料，与油价和金属价格冲击同步，并在油价回落后失去动能。这与H0的吻合程度高于需求拉动型复苏。

text_en: Private domestic demand has not turned. Property sales, mortgage flow, M1 and core CPI are all weak. The demand tests that pass do so on marginal second-derivative readings, not on strength.
text_zh: 私人部门内需尚未转向。商品房销售、按揭贷款、M1和核心CPI均偏弱。已通过的需求检验靠的是边际上的二阶导数式读数，而非强劲的表现。

text_en: Policy impulse is fading rather than building: credit growth is decelerating and on-budget spending is barely growing, so policy is not yet bridging the gap left by private demand.
text_zh: 政策力度是在减弱而非累积：信贷增速放缓，预算内支出增长乏力，政策尚未填补私人需求留下的缺口。

text_en: Exports are a genuine support for nominal growth. But external demand cannot by itself make the turn sustainable under this thesis, which requires domestic demand confirmation.
text_zh: 出口对名义增长构成实实在在的支撑。但按照本命题的定义，仅靠外需无法使这一拐点具备可持续性，仍需内需的确认。

text_en: The price leg of the thesis is more likely than not to hold through 2027Q1. The factory-gate price level is well above a year earlier, so the deflator would turn negative again only if commodity prices fell back sharply.
text_zh: 命题中的价格一环在2027年一季度前维持的可能性大于不维持。出厂价格水平明显高于上年同期，因此只有大宗商品价格大幅回落，平减指数才会再度转负。

text_en: Year-to-date industrial profit growth has slowed in every month since May: {m5} in 2026-05, {m6} in 2026-06, {m7} in 2026-07 and {m8} in 2026-08.
text_zh: 规模以上工业企业利润累计同比增速自5月以来逐月放缓：2026年5月为{m5}，6月为{m6}，7月为{m7}，8月为{m8}。

text_en: Because year-to-date profit growth has been falling since May, growth in the latest single month is running below the cumulative rate. The headline year-to-date figure therefore overstates current profit momentum.
text_zh: 由于累计利润增速自5月以来持续回落，最新单月的利润增速低于累计增速。累计同比这一头条数字因此高估了当前的利润动能。

text_en: The year-to-date decline in property sales area has widened in every month since April: {a4} in 2026-04, {a5} in 2026-05, {a6} in 2026-06, {a7} in 2026-07 and {a8} in 2026-08.
text_zh: 商品房销售面积累计同比降幅自4月以来逐月扩大：2026年4月为{a4}，5月为{a5}，6月为{a6}，7月为{a7}，8月为{a8}。

text_en: Because the cumulative decline has widened every month since April, sales in the latest single months are weaker than the year-to-date rate. The change-based property test that passes compares August with the weak January-February starting point, so that pass reflects the weak early-year starting point more than a recent improvement.
text_zh: 累计降幅自4月以来逐月扩大，意味着最近几个单月的销售弱于累计降幅所显示的水平。已通过的那项基于变化的房地产检验，是把8月与年初（1—2月）偏弱的起点相比较，因此这一通过更多反映年初起点偏弱，而非近期改善。

text_en: Broad domestic-demand confirmation is still absent. By level, property sales, household mortgage flow, M1 and core CPI remain weak. The demand tests that do pass do so on marginal changes from weak levels, and the one forward-looking improvement, September manufacturing new orders above the expansion line, is not yet confirmed by its three-month average.
text_zh: 内需的广泛确认仍然缺位。从水平看，商品房销售、住户按揭贷款、M1和核心CPI依然偏弱；已通过的需求检验多来自弱势水平上的边际改善；而唯一的前瞻性改善——9月制造业新订单升至荣枯线上方——尚未得到三个月均值的确认。
